description: Say goodbye to cluttered floors and hello to a neat and organized shoe collection with The View Your Shoe Organiser by JoDo (WHITE). It's also a great accessory for your closet, keeping your clothes and accessories organized.Assembly is a breeze – simply snap the round circular tabs on the sides of the shoe slots organizer and adjust the height to your liking. The riser is perfect for storing adult, children's, toddler's, and baby's shoes, giving you the flexibility to organize your entire family's footwear collection.The View Your Shoe Organiser is made with thick, durable material and includes a large heel stop to ensure your shoes stay in place. It's a free-standing double-decker rack that can be used as a boot organizer, sneaker organizer, toddler shoe organizer, and more. You can even place it in a drawer to keep your shoes organized.One of the best things about this shoe organizer is its versatility – it can be used in a variety of ways to suit your specific needs. Store the lower shoe facing your shelf/rack to keep them clean and out of sight, or turn the shoe slot around to make them easier to grab. You can even place a pair of shoes on two slots and add a second pair on the upper level to maximize space.The View Your Shoe Organiser is the perfect solution for those looking to make the most of their closet space. Order now and enjoy a pricing that won't hurt your purse! It's also a great gift for women who love to keep their shoes and accessories organized.
